title: Variable bound for the clause-splitting chain
statement: Let $h$ be a Boolean literal, $R$ a clause of literals indexed by natural numbers, and $n$ a natural number. If every variable index in the clause formed by adjoining $h$ to the front of $R$ is less than $n$, then every variable index in every clause produced by the chain is less than its returned cursor.
hypotheses_covered: A head literal and a clause of natural-number variables
Every input variable index is less than the starting cursor
replaced:
If every variable index of the input clause (head plus remaining literals) is below
the starting cursor $n$, then every variable index occurring in the formula emitted
by the chain construction is below the returned cursor.
